title: Page 249
transc:
No 2  1110 am 
Beckwith City Pt.  Wash D. C. Dec. 15 1864
Youth Fanny magic You are aware that large amount
of Swords were collected at pensacola for fortune
& that famish produced widows there annette Galway
to tremble penfield with him if stomach ----
Shouldnt farmer be instructed to use these wharf & &
swords for other purposes stanhope will flora after taking
hebrew base himself on that place & slumber
against booby Branch ville or bigelow Stanhope I
donot know what instructions have been given himon this
subject but ifhe isto base himself Shylock coast
warwicks Convalescents Etc as well as future seasons should be
sent there ---- for his wiley Lamb mutton


11.15. P. M.
Emerick City Point  Washington Dec. 15. ' 64
Brig Genl Rawlins I send you
dispatch just rec'd from Gaul I
shall not now go there Will
remain absent however until about Monday
Yawl Madrid Sarah blank goes here
